MediaPipe Tasks Vision 1.1.1 (npm @mediapipe/tasks-vision): vision_bundle.mjs and wasm/vision_wasm_internal.*
and the BlazeFace short-range face detector model (blaze_face_short_range.tflite, float16, v1).

Used by Code&Paint's "face detail" option; everything runs in the browser, nothing is sent anywhere.
